text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Miles, the chemist of Adytum.
source_text: You see Miles, the chemist of Adytum.

text: 你看到麦尔斯，内城区的化学师。
source_text: 你看到麦尔斯，内城区的化学师。

text: You see a thin man in a white smock.
source_text: You see a thin man in a white smock.

text: 你看到一个装着白色工作服的瘦小男人。
source_text: 你看到一个装着白色工作服的瘦小男人。

text: I don't believe we've met. I'm Miles. What can I do for you?
source_text: I don't believe we've met. I'm Miles. What can I do for you?

text: 我不认为我们以前见过面。我是麦尔斯。能帮你什么忙？
source_text: 我不认为我们以前见过面。我是麦尔斯。能帮你什么忙？

text: I'm just looking around, thanks.
source_text: I'm just looking around, thanks.

text: 我随便转转，多谢。
source_text: 我随便转转，多谢。

text: That smock makes you look like a scientist. What are you studying?
source_text: That smock makes you look like a scientist. What are you studying?

text: 这工作服让你看起来像个科学家。你在研究什么？
source_text: 这工作服让你看起来像个科学家。你在研究什么？

text: Huh?
source_text: Huh?

text: 哈?
source_text: 哈?

text: Well, enjoy your stay in our little town.
source_text: Well, enjoy your stay in our little town.

text: 好吧，希望你在我们小镇过得愉快。
source_text: 好吧，希望你在我们小镇过得愉快。

text: I'm a chemist. Mostly, I make primer and powder so that we can re-use# the brass casings from bullets. But I also dabble with some other chemicals.
source_text:
I'm a chemist. Mostly, I make primer and powder so that we can re-use
# the brass casings from bullets. But I also dabble with some other chemicals.

text: 我是化学师。多数时候，我做雷管和火药。这样我们就能重新利用子弹壳。不过我也涉及一些别的化学药品。
source_text: 我是化学师。多数时候，我做雷管和火药。这样我们就能重新利用子弹壳。不过我也涉及一些别的化学药品。

text: So you make bullets for Adytum.
source_text: So you make bullets for Adytum.

text: 这么说来，你替内城区制造子弹。
source_text: 这么说来，你替内城区制造子弹。

text: Where do you get the sulfur, potassium nitrate, and other chemicals?
source_text: Where do you get the sulfur, potassium nitrate, and other chemicals?

text: 你从哪弄硫磺，硝酸钾和其他的化学制品？
source_text: 你从哪弄硫磺，硝酸钾和其他的化学制品？

text: What other chemicals do you work with?
source_text: What other chemicals do you work with?

text: 你还做些什么化学药品？
source_text: 你还做些什么化学药品？

text: Thanks for the information.
source_text: Thanks for the information.

text: 多谢你提供的信息。
source_text: 多谢你提供的信息。

text: Yes, although Smitty is the one who actually casts the bullets.# I just refill the brass casings.
source_text:
Yes, although Smitty is the one who actually casts the bullets.
# I just refill the brass casings.

text: 是，虽然实际上是施密蒂在造弹头。我只是给弹壳内充填火药。
source_text: 是，虽然实际上是施密蒂在造弹头。我只是给弹壳内充填火药。

text: But the Hub merchants make a profit off of you and the town.
source_text: But the Hub merchants make a profit off of you and the town.

text: 不过哈勃城商人们利用你和这个镇子来赚钱。
source_text: 不过哈勃城商人们利用你和这个镇子来赚钱。

text: It's unusual to find someone who can appreciate chemistry!# But to answer your question, some of the materials we get from Hub merchants;# others I manufacture or just find in the area. For instance, the dung heaps# from the Brahmin are a good source, as well as some of the strains of fungus# that I cultivate.
source_text:
It's unusual to find someone who can appreciate chemistry!
# But to answer your question, some of the materials we get from Hub merchants;
# others I manufacture or just find in the area. For instance, the dung heaps
# from the Brahmin are a good source, as well as some of the strains of fungus
# that I cultivate.

text: 士为知己者死，女为悦己者容！找到个真正懂化学的可真不容易！好，回答你的问题，有些材料来自哈勃城商人；其他的，我自己做或者就地取材。例如，双头牛的粪堆是个不错的来源，和我自己培养的一些真菌一样好用。
source_text: 士为知己者死，女为悦己者容！找到个真正懂化学的可真不容易！好，回答你的问题，有些材料来自哈勃城商人；其他的，我自己做或者就地取材。例如，双头牛的粪堆是个不错的来源，和我自己培养的一些真菌一样好用。

text: Well, I've been trying to get some strong acids so that Smitty can use# them for etching. I also have been trying to make some permanent dyes and inks.# But without access to natural inks, it's difficult.
source_text:
Well, I've been trying to get some strong acids so that Smitty can use
# them for etching. I also have been trying to make some permanent dyes and inks.
# But without access to natural inks, it's difficult.

text: 嗯，我在试做一些强酸给施密蒂做蚀刻。我还试着制作一些持久的染料和墨水。不过没有自然的墨水，这很难做。
source_text: 嗯，我在试做一些强酸给施密蒂做蚀刻。我还试着制作一些持久的染料和墨水。不过没有自然的墨水，这很难做。

text: Any time.
source_text: Any time.

text: 随时。
source_text: 随时。

text: Oh dear. I'm afraid I can't help you.
source_text: Oh dear. I'm afraid I can't help you.

text: 哦，天啊。恐怕我帮不了你。
source_text: 哦，天啊。恐怕我帮不了你。

text: Hello again. Can I help you?
source_text: Hello again. Can I help you?

text: 再次欢迎。能帮上什么忙吗？
source_text: 再次欢迎。能帮上什么忙吗？

text: Yes, well, we have to make a living. Since the hydroponic farms aren't# functioning, we have to buy food from the merchants, and bullets are the only# thing we have to sell.
source_text:
Yes, well, we have to make a living. Since the hydroponic farms aren't
# functioning, we have to buy food from the merchants, and bullets are the only
# thing we have to sell.

text: 是的，你看，我们必须生存下去。自从水栽培农场无法开工，我们不得不从商人那买食物，子弹是我们唯一能卖的。
source_text: 是的，你看，我们必须生存下去。自从水栽培农场无法开工，我们不得不从商人那买食物，子弹是我们唯一能卖的。

text: I could try to get the parts to fix the hydroponic farms.
source_text: I could try to get the parts to fix the hydroponic farms.

text: 我可以试着找找修复水栽培农场的部件。
source_text: 我可以试着找找修复水栽培农场的部件。

text: Oh. Well, that's too bad.
source_text: Oh. Well, that's too bad.

text: 哦。你看，那太糟糕了。
source_text: 哦。你看，那太糟糕了。

text: Really? That would be wonderful! We're just missing a few parts, but# I'm sure that  if you could scrounge up the right pieces, we could be# self-sufficient! Sammael might be able to give you some help.
source_text:
Really? That would be wonderful! We're just missing a few parts, but
# I'm sure that  if you could scrounge up the right pieces, we could be
# self-sufficient! Sammael might be able to give you some help.

text: 真的吗？那太好了！我们就是差了那些部件，不过我肯定如果你找到合适的部件，我们就能够自给自足。山谬会告诉你更多。
source_text: 真的吗？那太好了！我们就是差了那些部件，不过我肯定如果你找到合适的部件，我们就能够自给自足。山谬会告诉你更多。

text: Have you found the parts yet?
source_text: Have you found the parts yet?

text: 你找到部件了吗？
source_text: 你找到部件了吗？

text: Yes, here they are.
source_text: Yes, here they are.

text: 是的，这些就是。
source_text: 是的，这些就是。

text: Not yet, who did you say I should ask about them?
source_text: Not yet, who did you say I should ask about them?

text: 还没，你刚才说我要找谁问关于这些部件的事情？
source_text: 还没，你刚才说我要找谁问关于这些部件的事情？

text: You'll need to talk to Sammael. You'll usually find him in# a tent down by the farms during the day.
source_text:
You'll need to talk to Sammael. You'll usually find him in
# a tent down by the farms during the day.

text: 你应该和山谬谈谈。一般白天的时候到农场附近的帐篷里可以找到他。
source_text: 你应该和山谬谈谈。一般白天的时候到农场附近的帐篷里可以找到他。

text: 【Miles looks over the parts】 Those are them, but it looks like# Smitty is going to have to do a little work on them.# Can you take them over to him?
source_text:
【Miles looks over the parts】 Those are them, but it looks like
# Smitty is going to have to do a little work on them.
# Can you take them over to him?

text: 【麦尔斯看着部件】是它们，不过看来施密蒂要对它们做些加工。你能把它们给他送过去吗？
source_text: 【麦尔斯看着部件】是它们，不过看来施密蒂要对它们做些加工。你能把它们给他送过去吗？

text: I've got other things to deal with.  Can you do it yourself?
source_text: I've got other things to deal with.  Can you do it yourself?

text: 我有别的事要处理。你能自己做这事吗？
source_text: 我有别的事要处理。你能自己做这事吗？

text: Sure, I'll be back after he's fixed them.
source_text: Sure, I'll be back after he's fixed them.

text: 好，他修好后我会再来。
source_text: 好，他修好后我会再来。

text: Sure, I appreciate you finding them for us.
source_text: Sure, I appreciate you finding them for us.

text: 好，非常感谢你替我们找到它们。
source_text: 好，非常感谢你替我们找到它们。

text: And . . .
source_text: And . . .

text: 还有……
source_text: 还有……

text: Not a problem.
source_text: Not a problem.

text: 没问题。
source_text: 没问题。

text: Oh. I almost forgot. Here is some stuff, for your trouble.# 【Miles hands you some caps and some stimpacks.】
source_text:
Oh. I almost forgot. Here is some stuff, for your trouble.
# 【Miles hands you some caps and some stimpacks.】

text: 哦。我差点忘了。东西在这，麻烦你了。【麦尔斯递给你一些钱和治疗针。】
source_text: 哦。我差点忘了。东西在这，麻烦你了。【麦尔斯递给你一些钱和治疗针。】

text: Were you able to take the parts over to Smitty?
source_text: Were you able to take the parts over to Smitty?

text: 你能把这些部件带给施密蒂吗？
source_text: 你能把这些部件带给施密蒂吗？

text: 【Miles takes the fixed parts from you】 Looks like Smitty did a great job on# these. Thanks for the help, and here's some stuff for your trouble.
source_text:
【Miles takes the fixed parts from you】 Looks like Smitty did a great job on
# these. Thanks for the help, and here's some stuff for your trouble.

text: 【麦尔斯从你这拿走修好的部件】看起来施密蒂干得不错。多谢你的帮忙，这里有些东西聊表谢意。
source_text: 【麦尔斯从你这拿走修好的部件】看起来施密蒂干得不错。多谢你的帮忙，这里有些东西聊表谢意。

text: 【Miles hands you some caps and some stimpacks.】
source_text: 【Miles hands you some caps and some stimpacks.】

text: 【麦尔斯递给你一些钱和治疗针。】
source_text: 【麦尔斯递给你一些钱和治疗针。】

text: If you ever get back this way, you might want to look me and Smitty up.# We might be able to help you out with some adjustments to some of your equipment.# Smitty can work wonders with certain weapons, and I can help out with# certain sorts of armor.
source_text:
If you ever get back this way, you might want to look me and Smitty up.
# We might be able to help you out with some adjustments to some of your equipment.
# Smitty can work wonders with certain weapons, and I can help out with
# certain sorts of armor.

text: 无论什么时候你再到这来，来找我和施密蒂。我们可以帮你校调装备。施密蒂对某些武器很在行，我可以处理某些装甲。
source_text: 无论什么时候你再到这来，来找我和施密蒂。我们可以帮你校调装备。施密蒂对某些武器很在行，我可以处理某些装甲。

text: Looks like you found some Power Armor. I've heard of a chemical process# that I could use to harden the surface of the armor. However, I'm missing some# information which could give me the last few clues to the formula and# reagents necessary.  I've heard the Librarian in the Hub, Mrs. Stapleton,# has some journals and books that might be of use.# If you could get those from there, I could probably test the process# on your armor.
source_text:
Looks like you found some Power Armor. I've heard of a chemical process
# that I could use to harden the surface of the armor. However, I'm missing some
# information which could give me the last few clues to the formula and
# reagents necessary.  I've heard the Librarian in the Hub, Mrs. Stapleton,
# has some journals and books that might be of use.
# If you could get those from there, I could probably test the process
# on your armor.

text: 看来你找到动力装甲了。我知道一种化学处理可以强化装甲表面。不过，我丢了些资料，这些资料是一些有关化学公式和试剂的提示。我听说哈勃城的图书管理员，斯塔布雷顿夫人，有些学术期刊和专业书籍可能有用。如果你能拿，我会在你的装甲上试试这种化学强化处理。
source_text: 看来你找到动力装甲了。我知道一种化学处理可以强化装甲表面。不过，我丢了些资料，这些资料是一些有关化学公式和试剂的提示。我听说哈勃城的图书管理员，斯塔布雷顿夫人，有些学术期刊和专业书籍可能有用。如果你能拿，我会在你的装甲上试试这种化学强化处理。

text: Sounds good. I'll go talk to Mrs. Stapleton.
source_text: Sounds good. I'll go talk to Mrs. Stapleton.

text: 听起来不错。我去和斯塔布雷顿夫人谈谈。
source_text: 听起来不错。我去和斯塔布雷顿夫人谈谈。

text: I got better things to do then fetch something else for you.
source_text: I got better things to do then fetch something else for you.

text: 我有更好的事情要做然后再替你弄些别的东西。
source_text: 我有更好的事情要做然后再替你弄些别的东西。

text: Well, if you ever change your mind, just go see Mrs. Stapleton# and then head on back here.
source_text:
Well, if you ever change your mind, just go see Mrs. Stapleton
# and then head on back here.

text: 好吧，如果你改变想法了，就去看看斯塔布雷顿夫人，再回到这里。
source_text: 好吧，如果你改变想法了，就去看看斯塔布雷顿夫人，再回到这里。

text: Had a chance to get to the Hub yet and visit Mrs. Stapleton?
source_text: Had a chance to get to the Hub yet and visit Mrs. Stapleton?

text: 找到时间去哈勃城拜访一下斯塔布雷顿夫人了吗？
source_text: 找到时间去哈勃城拜访一下斯塔布雷顿夫人了吗？

text: Yeah, here are the books.
source_text: Yeah, here are the books.

text: 嗯，就是这些书。
source_text: 嗯，就是这些书。

text: Not yet.
source_text: Not yet.

text: 还没。
source_text: 还没。

text: 【Miles takes the books from you, and starts flipping through them.】 Hmmmm.# Yes, hmmmm. 【He mumbles to himself for a few more minutes.】# Well, I think I can figure it out, but it will take a full day# for the bonding to occur. Is that acceptable?
source_text:
【Miles takes the books from you, and starts flipping through them.】 Hmmmm.
# Yes, hmmmm. 【He mumbles to himself for a few more minutes.】
# Well, I think I can figure it out, but it will take a full day
# for the bonding to occur. Is that acceptable?

text: 【麦尔斯拿走了书，开始翻看。】嗯。对，嗯。【他自言自语的嘀咕了一阵】好，我想我搞明白了，不过要花一整天才能处理完。可以接受吧？
source_text: 【麦尔斯拿走了书，开始翻看。】嗯。对，嗯。【他自言自语的嘀咕了一阵】好，我想我搞明白了，不过要花一整天才能处理完。可以接受吧？

text: Not a problem.
source_text: Not a problem.

text: 没问题。
source_text: 没问题。

text: Sorry, don't have the time.
source_text: Sorry, don't have the time.

text: 抱歉，没时间等了。
source_text: 抱歉，没时间等了。

text: Well, when you have the time, come back and I'll do the process# on your armor.
source_text:
Well, when you have the time, come back and I'll do the process
# on your armor.

text: 好，等你有时间了，再回来我会替你处理装甲。
source_text: 好，等你有时间了，再回来我会替你处理装甲。

text: 【Miles takes your armor from you.】
source_text: 【Miles takes your armor from you.】

text: 【麦尔斯拿走了装甲。】
source_text: 【麦尔斯拿走了装甲。】

text: 【Miles hands your armor back to you, it seems to glint a# little more than it did before.】 Well, I think it worked! Hope it helps you out.
source_text:
【Miles hands your armor back to you, it seems to glint a
# little more than it did before.】 Well, I think it worked! Hope it helps you out.

text: 【麦尔斯把装甲还给了你，它看起来比以前更加闪亮。】好，我想这种化学强化方法成功了！希望它能给你些帮助。
source_text: 【麦尔斯把装甲还给了你，它看起来比以前更加闪亮。】好，我想这种化学强化方法成功了！希望它能给你些帮助。

text: What happened to your power armor? I can only help you out# if you have power armor.
source_text:
What happened to your power armor? I can only help you out
# if you have power armor.

text: 你的能量装甲怎么了？你有了能量装甲我才能帮得了你。
source_text: 你的能量装甲怎么了？你有了能量装甲我才能帮得了你。

text: Nice to see you, but I'm right in the middle of some research.
source_text: Nice to see you, but I'm right in the middle of some research.

text: 很高兴看到你，不过我还在研究。
source_text: 很高兴看到你，不过我还在研究。

text: Nothing I can do with that type of armor. Sorry.
source_text: Nothing I can do with that type of armor. Sorry.

text: 对这种装甲我无能为力。抱歉。
source_text: 对这种装甲我无能为力。抱歉。
